definitions.full: H5384. nasheh נָשֶׁה noun [masculine] a vein (or nerve) in the thigh (etymology dubious; on formative compare Lag BN 50 ; Arabic apparently the portion of the principal vein of the leg which is in the thigh , vulgar sciatic vein , or (modern) sciatic nerve and even sciatica , Lane 3033 ); — only הַנָּשֶׁה גִּיד Gen Genesis 32:33a the sinew of the thigh-vein (or thigh-nerve , הַיָּרֵךְ עַלכַּֿף אֲשֶׁר ), compare v33b. — On sacredness of thigh, compare RS Sem i. 360; 2nd ed. 380 We Heid (2), 168. נָשִׁים see אִשָּׁה above
